title: Clash of Clans Intro
blurb: Supercell opened a billion village-checking sessions with a war horn, and mobile gaming has never produced three more nostalgic seconds. Clash of Clans launched in 2012 and colonised an entire era of school breaks and commutes — hearing the fanfare teleports a generation straight back to raid planning, shield timers and the specific anxiety of having all five builders busy. Play it before any strategic undertaking, whether that is an actual game, a difficult email, or the negotiation over how a restaurant bill gets divided.
origin: The startup fanfare from Clash of Clans (Supercell).
